text: Which recent result was most significant for showing that HoTT can directly support large-scale computation?
choices: Brunerie's Cubical Agda verification of π₄(S³)=ℤ/2ℤ (showing a proof term from cubical TT fully normalises)
explanation: Brunerie's result (verified ~2022 in Cubical Agda): the proof term for π₄(S³)=ℤ/2ℤ normalises to ℤ/2ℤ. This demonstrates that cubical TT has genuine computational content for advanced homotopy theory.
